Description: A drifting work style is the destiny for those who graduated from the department of civil engineering and the graduate school of architecture. From Kaohsiung to Taipei, and from Taiwan to the Mainland to every corner around the world, either for work or business, with bitterness and happiness, I am a wanderer between cities, staying at different hotels at night. The silver moonlight, however, is the one thing that never changes no matter whether the streets are booming or quiet. Shone by the streetlight, those extravagantly adorned 5-star hotels provide the comfort of brand-name beds, whereas in the ordinarily equipped, confined room of business hotels, only beds of slightly insufficient length and roughness to be had. These only make me feel the lack of warmth being away from home. The pillows without my own smell arouse the homesickness deep inside of me in the depth of night. I miss home. We all have what it takes to plan, design, build and decorate a beautiful, comfortable, warm and safe house of our own. Those who travel anywhere owing to the highly developed global village without their own permanent residence want a hotel to be "like home" for their time staying there. An inconspicuous old building on the Qixian 2nd Rd. was thus given a new life by our expertise, dedication and persistence. It is hoped, whether it is because of business, work or travel, those who are far away from home and destined to spend a night at out place will find it like home with all its comfort and relief. Come visit us! Be a part of this big family. You will find it just like moving into a new house upon your stay first time. From then on, end every time you happen to be in Kaohsiung, you will have an impulse to go back to your home at "Hoyang Business Hotel." Now that our "Hoyang Business Hotel" is open for business, we hope our dedication, business philosophy and passion touch deep down inside all of you who ever spent a night here. And you will miss your home of Kaohsiung - "Hoyang Business Hotel."

Name: Orange Moon Inn
Description: 屏東｜Orange Moon InnOrange vacation beneath a century-old breadfruit treeTurning a corner off Kenting’s Main Street and heading down a small lane, you embark on a stroll through the daily happenings of this southern Taiwanese town. A little down the lane, you encounter a stately breadfruit tree that has inhabited this place for a century. Tucked away in the shade of the tree sits Orange Moon Inn, almost as if extending both hands to you in welcome. Your vacation is about to be immersed in the orange warmth of Kenting.A life adorned with the warmth of the sunPerhaps because it sits in the embrace of a breadfruit tree, as you push open the wooden doors of Orange Moon Inn, you are struck by the gentle warmth of the midsummer sun dancing on the orange interior walls. However simple and reserved, the wooden space with its bare cement walls is not devoid of texture. The simple decor is offset by various displays of adorable goods which from time to time surprises you with their orange ingenuity. Genial collectibles and stacks of books adorn the stairwell, inherited from the “Orange Moon Bookstore” once owned and operated in Kenting by host and guesthouse owner, Alumi. Feel free to peruse which ever book may catch your eye.Orange Moon Inn is a split-level structure, and each half-storey level is represented by a different color and botanical theme. For instance, the romantic Rose level is painted in passionate red, while the Ginger Lily level is clad in calming blue. A number of specially crafted carvings represent such local flowers as Small-leaved Barringtonia, Narrow-leaved Dracaena, Frangipani, and others, all indigenous to Pingtung county. The four-person rooms are suitable for groups of friends, while, in consideration of lone travelers, Orange Moon Inn also offers single rooms. If you’re travelling alone, Orange Moon Inn has the perfect nook for you to enjoy. Architectural aesthetics in dialogue with spaceThe eight conceptually colored rooms spread across four stories are replete with ingenuity, inspiring a kind of dialogue between travelers and the building they inhabit. The facade of the cement wall in the entrance is modeled after traditional iron window grates. As the second floor atrium running up through the entire building allows sunlight to trickle downwards, it also invites the wind into Orange Moon Inn, inspiring the atmosphere with rhythmic life. Having been retrofitted by Alumi with a pneumatic luggage elevator, the Orange Moon Inn has integrated an increasingly simple aesthetic. The purpose: to provide each and every traveler the right amount of space to enjoy true freedom and ease.All of these design concepts were generated by guesthouse owner Alumi himself. Alumi once acted as editor in chief of his university magazine, at which time he developed his seemingly endless ingenuity in artistic culture and design. Alumi was previously the owner of a bookstore here in Kenting, when his wife began to dream of opening a bed and breakfast. “Architecture needs to correspond to the environment, and must harmonize with it, the experience of which cannot be replaced by any particular style of interior design.” With such staunch dedication to architectural aesthetics, Alumi resolved to introduce sunlight and shade, wind and form into his design. Close your eyes and you can hear the space breathe, as if all the sunlight and tranquility of Kenting has been gathered in this place.Jubilant mornings beneath the breadfruit treeBreakfast is made fresh every morning. Travelers who stay more than one night will be treated to different breakfast creations every day. Sitting in the wooden space of the main hall as a hot chicken sandwich is placed on the table, you enjoy every toasty bite, washing it down with ice-cold milk tea in a state of pure satisfaction.Before you leave Orange Moon Inn, why not linger a moment beneath the breadfruit tree! Look into the near distance and see the morning sun shining upon Dajianshan mountain and the pastures of Kenting ranch. Beneath the hundred-year-old breadfruit tree, tucked away down a little lane, enjoy your very own orange vacation.

Description: The museum started off with a humble beginning as a woodcarving workshop. Later in 1988, it functioned as a woodcarving school that mainly conducted classes for young children between ages 10 and 12. The overwhelming responses for classes inspired the establishment of the current Face Painting Cultural Museum, which combines the art of wood carving and the art of Chinese Opera face painting together.      More than a thousand traditional Chinese Opera face paintings are displayed in the museum, each exquisitely designed by the owner's family of 4 during the SARS period from 1992 to 1995. The SARS crisis was a blessing in disguise that provided the family with an opportunity to transform the site into the current Face Painting Cultural Museum. The gallery of face painting art pieces not only enhances the beauty of the place, but also represents the fruits of their hard work.

Description: Penghu｜ DaydreamCotton candy spaceship sailing the white clouds of a dreamOutside the car window, carefree white clouds drift in the blue sky, stirring up the wanderlust of the travelers within. The radio provides melodious accompaniment invoking further flights of fancy. Beside the road sits Daydream, Penghu Islands’ enchanting guesthouse, like a cotton candy spaceship just waiting to fly you away!Summer fantasyOpen the gates to this dreamland and behold a fantasy paradise out of a young girl’s daydream. A princess bed sits in the middle of a vast green field. Teak lounge chairs surround an inviting, clear swimming pool. Glance westward and behold an endless ocean view. There’s a variety of charming inflatable swim rings floating upon the clear water of the pool. The whole summer scene seems to have burst from a dream.Only when Heshi, the owner of this dreamland, walks out the front doors in her flowery skirt to greet you do you realize that this place is truly real. You follow Heshi into Daydream guesthouse, contemplating the relaxing atmosphere and princess-style decor which seems just like a little girl’s fantasy land.A daydream canvasThe high ceilings and huge windows make for a spacious and bright lobby. Macaron-colored sofa cushions catch the eye like bright paint splattered across a canvas. Tasty brown sugar cakes and tisane tea, a local specialty, sit welcomingly on the table before you. Travelers move unconstrained throughout the space.As you stroll up the stairs and along the outdoor balcony, you observe the attentive efforts Heshi has put into the creation of this white dreamland. Moon and star inlays decorate pure white walls. Cute little sailor dolls adorn window sills. Every element of the decor and design was executed personally by Heshi and her family, with their cute and dainty ornaments appearing in every corner as if awaiting to surprise you upon arrival!Tiptoeing in the cloudsYou enter a room, where a basket of exquisite Verbena bath products and velvety soft slippers sits on the bed waiting for you. The slippers are customized according to Heshi’s requirements. She wants you to feel so comfortable it’s as if you’re walking above the clouds, making sure that every second you spend at Daydream is a real sensual experience.The room overlooking the ocean offers more than just an impressive seaside view - the Penghu sunset makes a daily appearance as well. After dark, if your visit happens to be during the Penghu Fireworks Festival, you can admire the fireworks exploding into colorful blooms in the distance out of the same windows. No matter what time it is at Daydream guesthouse, the most splendid views are there for you just outside the window.Daydream guesthouse does everything possible to give you a genuine dreamland experience. In the future, whenever you look out the window of a plane and see white clouds drifting through blue skies, you’ll think of that time when you rode the cotton candy spaceship in Penghu.

Description: The ancient houses in Kinmen are like pieces of art work, fused with western architectural esthetics and eastern classical flavor, which have been left behind by time. Relax in the Taiwan pine forest and pasture to talk to the breeze, pine forest and chirping birds and insects. There are several famous destinations, including Jiji (15 minutes driving), Sun Moon Lake (30 minutes driving), and Shuili Snakekiln (10 minutes of walking). Also, Taichung International Airport and HSR Taichung Station takes only about an hour of driving, and it's convenient to reach Checheng Recreational Agriculture Area, Sun Moon Lake National Scenic Area and Dream Works of the Mei in Xinyi Township. Description: Penghu｜Migrant Intertidal GuesthouseMigratory Birds Return to Roost in their Primitive Ocean HometownYou turn into a small village before Baisha township and the road leads seamlessly straight up to the inner Penghu ocean. As for the migratory bird intertidal zone, it is unique to this ocean area and is less than 20 meters from the hostel. Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse welcomes you city birds to return to your primitive, natural seaside home.White migratory birds perched in the intertidal zoneThe irregular design of the building, like a white migratory bird preparing to take flight, is caressed by the southern summer winds. The bright, yellow beach and expansive ocean scenery in front of the guesthouse, the independent docks and the beautiful vistas of the intertidal zone; all of these ecological landscapes before your eyes fluctuate with the ebb and flow of the tide and the come and go of daylight. These elements combine into a veritable painting of priceless abundant vitality wherein, each moment, a new and moving vista appears.Besides embracing the intertidal zone along the shore in front of the guesthouse, the name of Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse originates from hosts Amy and Ken’s love of birds. They are both members of the Penghu Wild Birds Association and are passionate about everything relating to birds on the island. They also look forward to helping all their city-dwelling guests to feel as if they are returning to roost, to invite them to come back regularly to enjoy the intact natural ecosystem as well as their own oceanside home.Earnest perception of the simplest blessings and happiness “There is really nothing special about our home, as there’s nothing of note in this area. All we have is our earnest perception and appreciation.” In the words of Amy, Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse doesn’t have any ornate decorations or elaborate designs, but is rather a return to primitive natural happiness, all of which is made possible by one’s willingness to “perceive”.Open your mind and strive to perceive, then! Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse will help you open your senses and your mind, and to cultivate an even more attentive attitude toward experiencing nature. Perhaps it will happen in the morning, when welcoming the sunrise over the ocean, or perhaps when observing the A-New, the guesthouse dog, running down to the ocean to frolic excitedly in the water. Or perhaps it will come to you in the morning over breakfast when you experience the taste of Zhongji baked sesame seed-coated cakes for the first time. In any case, you’ll experience so many moving moments in this place. Nighttime exploration of intertidal pools!Yet the most unforgettable experience on offer at Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse is surely exploring the intertidal pools in the pitch-black darkness of night. Follow Ken on a magnificent intertidal nighttime adventure! Holding your flashlight, you put on shorts and sandals and, stepping over the vines on the beach, you enter the knee-high tidal pool. You catch sight of bright, silver clove fish as their slender bodies dart to and fro beneath the surface. They bump into your legs as you pass through and, before you have time to get used to this clove fish encounter, to your delighted surprise, Ken picks up a plump, round blowfish, spines protruding at all angles. If you make the trip to Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse, you simply cannot pass up the opportunity to go out with Ken to explore the abundant ecological wonders of the intertidal pools. It will be a meeting with nature that you won’t soon forget!It’s hard to imagine that, after leaving the intertidal pools and returning to the guesthouse, yet another surprise awaits: a bowl full of a summer-season delicacy - fresh oysters! You use tongs to hold the shells of the oysters while you remove the rich milky flesh. No matter how much you eat, you never get tired of these oysters, especially when washed down with a cup of draft beer. How delightful!Life is simple at Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse, yet the experience is rich and plentiful. For city-dwelling travelers who are weary of the bustle of everyday life, it is a true blessing to return to such a place, like migratory birds returning to roost each year. After visiting such a place, with spirits revitalized, you can set off to achieve your next big goal.

Description: The Lou Zi Xia Traditional-Style Taiwanese Bed & Breakfast was planned and renovated by Kinmen National Park and operated by the Cai sisters from Qiong Lin Community. Three sisters manage No. 79, 92, and 105. The B&B includes 12 suites accomodating up to 34 people. Groups and individuals welcome. Facilities include a BBQ grill and ingredients. After spending a day around the island, travelers can come back and barbecue, sip tea, or chat with friends under a starry night. Enjoy the serenity and a break from the stress and bustle of the city. As an environmentally-friendly B&B, Lou Zi Xia Traditional-Style Taiwanese Bed & Breakfast complies with the Kinmen Low-Carbon Program by not automatically providing disposable toiletries or changing bedding and towels for guests staying more than one night. Qiong Lin Community is located in the center of the island, and is one of its representative communities. The original name for this area, “Pinglin,” came from the forests that used to grow nearby. It has been frequented by famous people since the Ming dynasty, when one of the emperors bestowed an honorary inscribed board from which the current name, “Qiong Lin,” is derived. A number of traditional-style Taiwanese buildings, simple and elegant, with natural charm, have been preserved here. The largest of these is the ancestral temple. During times of war, tunnels were dug around the island and it had a heavy military atmosphere; now it is open to the public. Qiong Lin was home to a number of successful scholars during the Ming and Qing dynasties, and therefore a number of ornate official residences can still be viewed here. The ancestral temples are full of inscribed boards celebrating the scholars’ achievements, and in addition to the main Cai Family Temple, several more representing the branches of the family can be found in Qiong Lin. One building houses two of these temples. Each of the temples provides interesting sights, and along with Yi Gu Tang and two of Feng Shi Ye (Wind Lion Gods) have been designated second-grade historical sites.

Description: Yilan｜Fengchun VillaA Mountain Retreat that is Peaceful Year RoundA fine drizzle falls upon the leaves, sliding off into the pool below one drop at a time. You stand and look into the distance, and beyond the water droplets sparkling on the soft lawn, an immense scene unfolds before your eyes: layers of dark and light green leading up to mountain peaks, with a light blue stream tracing a path across it all. The clouds and mist slowly disperse, little by little revealing the mountain’s complexion. Rain or shine, this mountain retreat is peaceful year round - Fengchun Villa.A tranquil residence concealed within the mountainsAfter following a winding little road up into the mountains, you park your car and let the refreshing air encircle your nose. To one side, the main doors have been left open for you, so you stroll into the hidden territory which is Fengchun Villa. You admire the lush lawn beside the sloping road, decorated with a few European statues and wooden lawn chairs. You walk deeper into the gardens and Lilysan comes forward extending a warm greeting. Arriving at the semi-open scenic lookout space, you enjoy the tea and snacks that have been prepared for you: organic honey fragrance black tea from a nearby tea farm, dragon fruit from Fengchun Villa’s own gardens, and green bean cakes. You look out over the vast scenery before you as any worries that were hiding deep in your heart are carried away on the gentle mountain breeze.Fengchun Villa was established in 1989 when Lilysan finished her previous business and bought this vacation garden property. Nearly four acres in size, Lilysan and her family prepared and constructed it all themselves. They didn’t expect that this quiet mountain lifestyle, away from the bustle of the city, would attract many family and friends to visit. This inspired the family to construct a white, European style building to serve as a guesthouse, choosing to name it Fengchun after the pen name of an ancestor. As a way to allow the name of their ancestors’ Fengchun Trading Company to live on, they used the same enthusiasm to operate Fengchun Villa as their ancestors did their trading company.An intimate time for self-healingStepping into the house, you smell the mild fragrance of cunninghamia, a type of cypress wood imported from Laos, and it puts your mind at ease. The various guest rooms are named after local birds and are available in many different layouts to meet the different needs of travelers. Taking off your shoes, you admire the abundant greenery outside the massive windows. Reclining beside a window or walking out onto the balcony, the gentle golden light of sunset caresses your body. You pour yourself a hot cup of tea and in this way, feel the slow passage of time. You reserve the afternoon just for yourself, allowing the peaceful view to wash the exhaustion from your train of thoughts. In Fengchun Villa, besides the enjoyment of spacious interior accommodations, you can also make reservations for an infrared foot bath, sauna, or energy space experience. In the evening, the Fengchun Villa menu of rich and sumptuous mountain cuisine is sure to satisfy your taste buds and completely relax both your body and mind.Relaxed and restful mountain lifeThe gentle morning sun signals the start of a new day, urging you toward the table to enjoy a lavish breakfast. You admire the elaborate oil paintings of your host as the mountain air fills you with energy. As a part of your spontaneous vacation, you might set off with your hosts on a scavenger hunt into the mountains, or make reservations for a Chinese tea ceremony. Either of these may help you regain a healthy rhythm for your life, allowing you to experience true comfort from the bottom of your heart, and enjoy the carefree passage of time in the mountains!

Name: Xiangyang Tianyuan Ju Homestay
Description: Sunny Villa—Our sincerity brings you a memorable journey.Sunny Villa is run by a retired teacher Mei-hui Su and her daughter-in-law Wei-rong Yang. “Sunny” is our attitude—we are always optimistic. We treat every visitor as our close friend, hoping to radiate soothing warmth anytime. On July 14, 2012, Sunny Villa was reported in Liberty Times, “Sunny Villa often sponsors local cultural and artistic activities and it puts Dongshan Section in the spotlight.” It was also chosen as one of the best stores in Tainan in 2014. Sunny Villa earnestly invites you to join our rural and humanistic feast.Director Hsu of Tainan City Government once saw our Honors Award Wall and said, “Sunny Villa is Miss Ho Yang’s (a writer) home.” Many visitors like Miss Yang’s wonderful sense of humor. Qin-han (a famous writer) complimented Miss Yang as the most attractive pictue in Sunny Villa. We often invites writers to stay here so that the visitors get the chance to have a close contact with them.In our garden, we set up a board with the word “laughchi” on it to promote the popularity of “laughchi.” On June 26, 2014, Liberty Times Net reported, “Laughchi makes Sunny Villa famous overnight. Granny Wang could’t stop laughing and she asked her son to show their utmost appreciation to the host at Sunny Villa.” Besides, we advocate jogging in the country road. We run with our visitors all around the neighborhood. In this way, our visitors can stay healthy, and the local people join us to jog every day.Our guest rooms are named after the fruits we grow. The fruits are offered to our visitors for free. We hold the activity of fruit picking on local farms. Melons, dragon fruits, papayas, watermelons, tomatos, tangerines and longans are all local products. In addition, we like to share the information about the local customs, history, and people with our visitors.Our guest rooms are all laid with costly logs. Every room is pleasantly tidy and bright. All the sheets are purely clean with the sunny odor. In each room, you can see through the octangle windows a vista of green fields and coconut palms. You can simply do nothing but sit by the windows all day long watching the breathtaking sunrise, sunset and the beautiful panoramic views. The fresh air and the quiet country life will fully relax your body and soul.Mr. Lu (a well-known antique collector) is our frequent visitor. He has come here for fifty-four times. He said, “The room is big and comfortable. I can sleep well here.” Sunny Villa is also your best choice for class gathering or honeymoon. So far, sixteen newlyweds and their relatives have lodged here. Hakohato Sadao (a Japanese backpacker) gave so much praise to our hospitality. Mitchell, the retired chief of French Tourism Bureau, has stayed here for four times. He falls in love with our cordiality and friendliness.A report in Tainan City Industry Magazine says, “Sunny Villa—Its sincerity brings every visitor a memorable journey.” Our philosophy is LPCM. Love is the power to move forward. Passion is in our blood. Cultural heritage is our mission. Miracle stories in the region are waiting for us to explore.

Name: Redgarden Resort
Description: Pingtung｜Red Garden ResortA blooming secret garden in the south of TaiwanYou pass through Kenting’s bustling main street and head toward Sail Rock. The number of pedestrians gradually decreases until, finally, your only company is the sunny skyline along the coastal highway. You make a sudden turn up a sloping gravel lane and continue unhurriedly along until your eyes light up at the sight before you: behold Red Garden Resort.An exquisite garden abloom with vibrant lifeRed Garden Resort is hidden down a little alley in Sail Rock. Open the gate and you are greeted by a little garden facing out over the sea which, as the name implies, is full of colorful red flowers. Though small in size, the terrace is delicate and orderly, arranged into multiple impressive layers so that the style of the garden changes depending on where you stand. Small stone carvings imported from Bali hide between blossoming shrubs; here a tranquil Buddha, there a calm little crocodile. It’s as if they are keeping company with the flowers or playing with the travelers. No matter day or night, this enchanting venue allows you to linger a long, long time.In keeping with the design of the gardens, the dwelling of Red Garden Resort is equally bright and romantic. Walls are accentuated with passionate orange and bright yellow paint, and are covered with winding, dark green vines. Looking up at the windows of the top floor left slightly ajar, you might imagine this to be the Taiwanese abode of Rapunzel, unravelling her long, silk-like hair out those windows day and night, awaiting the arrival of her prince charming.An exquisite and enchanting Southeast Asian fairy taleAn ingenious mix of exotic decorations from Bali and various other indigenous cultures greets you as you step indoors, giving Red Garden Resort a uniquely tropical, southern style, at once subdued yet bold. The bathrooms exhibit clay bottles of shampoo and shower gel, and volcanic rock flooring, the varied heights of the design elements echoing the multi-level composition of the gardens outside. Lying on the white bedding of the large wooden bed late at night, you hear the faint lapping of waves against the seashore. The subtle yellow lighting, the fresh cut flowers and the scent of sandalwood in the air are so charming that you feel loathe to let sleep overtake you.Your hostess Amy, in her long, flowing skirt, is the beautiful caretaker of this elegant garden. Passionate and strong, Amy was born and raised in Kenting. Giving up her dream of being a professional soccer player, her athletic vigor and perseverance allowed her to go from serving in a hotel restaurant to become an apprentice at another establishment opened by the hotel chef where she learned to cook and to speak English. She later took charge of her own restaurant, at which time she met her true love, an Englishman named Neil. Red Garden Resort is the fruit of their labor, bearing witness to their good fortune and happiness.Blooming in the hearts of travelersOriginally employed in the field of shipbuilding design, Neil found himself making frequent trips to Taiwan. An avid surfer, he would escape to the beaches of Kenting nearly every week. It was on one of those trips that he met Amy, who was working in a restaurant he patronized. Their exotic foreign romance culminated in Neil giving up his career to stay in Taiwan and start a family with Amy. At that time, Amy was growing increasingly weary of her hectic restaurant job, and began to imagine the contentment of a leisurely lifestyle in a garden paradise. In order to fulfill his wife’s dreams, Neil once again took up his design profession. He drew up all the designs and oversaw the construction work himself. The details of Red Garden Resort took shape in each meticulously drawn blueprint, as if with each stroke of his pen, Neil was bringing his commitment to Amy to life, each gorgeous flower nurtured with his love for her. So long as they hold hands, the flowers in their garden will bloom eternally in brilliant red.When you stay at Red Garden Resort, you feel like you’ve arrived at your own private villa. The atmosphere gives travelers the warm sensation of returning home for the holidays. As you enjoy a delicious breakfast under the garden trellis, the sea breeze caresses your skin and the sound of ocean waves rolls in the distance. Sometimes, you might find yourself lounging in a garden chair with a good book, at others strolling the beach in the sunshine. Passing your days in such cordial comfort, you feel utterly free. For over ten years, it is precisely this secret that Red Garden Resort has been planting in the hearts of travelers.

Description: Tainan｜Chung Fu Inn Invigoration relay station for Tainan visitorsNo sooner do you leave the Tainan Train Station than the warm southern sun welcomes you. Rent a scooter at a nearby dealership, turn the ignition and set off! Turning into the lane, you see a three-story townhouse with ornate iron window grates, vestiges of former times. You push the wooden doors and enter Tainan’s Chung Fu Inn!Preserving the enchanting iron window grates of a townhouseChung Fu Inn is co-owned by a designer from Taipei and a building contractor from Jiayi. They were attending a wedding banquet in Tainan when the old local townhouses caught their eye. They went on to apply their respective specialties in refurbishing it and named it Chung Fu Inn, using one character from each of their names.Each of Chung Fu Inn’s two townhouses preserves the original brick walls and ornate iron window grates. Once you enter the lobby, you are greeted by antique Chinese medicine cabinets and an ancient television set, which belong to the owners’ personal collections. As you climb the stairs in the Da Fu building, you see the ornate cement air vents along the top of the hallway walls. The stairwell of the outbuilding has been painted in rich and various colors, giving the old edifice a novel and vivid look.In the Da Fu building, antique wooden frames are reborn as partition screens to divide the interior of the Tranquil Room. In the Shu Huo Room, an entire wall of ornate iron window grates creates charming inverted patterns in the sunlight. Inside the outbuilding, the decor of the little Qing Xin Room incorporates vivid blue wall paint and wood-framed cabinets. Raise your head as you walk up the stairs to the third floor, and you are greeted by an array of fluttering, white butterflies. When you sit in the old rocking chair in Small Balcony Room, the butterflies will guide you in recollections of beautiful bygone times.Wooden doors, tatami mats, antique sofasBeyond the townhouses, you find two wooden single-storey houses as you enter the alley near the park, each of which are rented by one party at a time. The living room of Villa Number 45 is furnished with two retro sofas, and an elevated room to one side offers you a place to sit and rest. Take the steps onto the second floor and find a tatami sleeping area under the slanted roof, where you enjoy the air made warm and fragrant by the sunlight.Across the way sits Villa Number 47, with a similar Japanese layout and decorative elements. The bathtub on the first floor is remarkable, but even more surprising is the polished bar counter at the far end of the living room! After night falls, a cork pops out of a bottle of red wine and glasses are poured one-third full. It’s bottoms up in a toast to friendship!Now this is the passion of Tainan! When it comes to Tainan, the most anticipated part for most people is all the delicious and diverse foods. Chung Fu Inn is assisted in this regard by a varied host of well-known snack vendors. Not only do the owners of Chung Fu Inn offer recommendations for local scenic spots but they are even considerate enough to prepare local refreshments for their guests. The feeling of friendship is richly felt at Chung Fu Inn and leaves an indelible impression of Tainan. Chung Fu Inn won’t be the last stop on your journey, but rather a relay station where you can rest and recharge. Take the cordiality of Tainan with you today as you mount your scooter, turn the key and set off on the next leg of your adventure!

Description: Blue Lagoon Penghu B&B sits near the tidal belt and Chenggong Reservoir, and the wetlands are home to all kinds of migratory birds all year round. Name: Roaming Cloud sunmoonlake B&B
Name_c: 散步的雲-日月潭生態民宿(特色民宿)
Description: Nantou｜Roaming Cloud B&BTake a walk with white clouds and embrace nature on this vacationAs you arrive in the outskirts of the Sun Moon Lake district, the mountain greenery around Yuchi Township unfolds before your eyes. Open the car window and breathe the fresh, clean air accompanied by the singing of birds and frogs. Built with a unique wooden pillar technique deep in the mountains, Roaming Cloud B&B is Taiwan’s first low-carbon construction guesthouse. Travelling to this guesthouse feels like flying off to a whole new landscape beyond the borders of Taiwan. The green building rooftop employs solar and wind energy to power the street lamps at night and bring the area to life.Boarding gate in a low carbon building You enter the garden area and see a flock of Japanese chickens waddling around, children playing joyfully in the sandbox, and a person in a rocking chair gazing at the distant mountains. No matter rain or shine, the view is always inspiring.Once behind the glass doors, a cute border collie named Rice Roll says hello from beside the wooden counter while French windows transport the verdant scenery inside. The interior space has high ceilings and ingeniously incorporates elements of airport design with the words “departure” and “arrival” written on the directions board. Even your room card is designed like a plane ticket, a pass permitting you travel to distant lands. On your way to your room, you walk past a shelf displaying vegetables from local farmers for sale, and a spacious restaurant surrounded by a betel palm forest.Six rooms, six exotic conceptsIn this two-storey building, you’ll find six different rooms, each with a unique theme designed and created by Steven, formerly a military professional, and his wife Lilian, who once worked as a flight attendant.Boarding Gate A1 leads to the Chinese style room with exclusive courtyard where you can sip tea and enjoy the breeze. A2 leads to the Japanese style room where, in the spring, you can sit outside in the covered corridor and admire the sakura blossoms as you allow your legs to soak in the cool water flowing through the yard. You can rest on the tatami or enjoy the barrier free bathroom, giving travelers more accommodations options. Up on the second floor, the public space consists of a reading area framed in solid wood with books, DVDs and games lining the wooden shelves. Starting your journey at Boarding Gate B1, the comfortable European country-style room can accommodate four travelers and has two separate washrooms. The B2 and B3 rooms have a loft design and are furnished with four-pillar beds, offering a Southeast Asian feel. In the B5 room, you can open the window and look out over an entire forest of betel palm.Enjoy a thorough guided tour of the local natural ecologyIn the morning, Steven and Lilian prepare a healthy, sumptuous breakfast for you. All the ingredients come from local, small-scale farmers and are prepared and presented in the most natural way so that you can taste and enjoy their pure, original flavor. After you’ve eaten your fill, you depart with Steven for a guided ecological tour! This two-hour excursion gives travelers a profound introduction to the local ecology and culture of Toushe.For the first stop on the tour, you change into rubber boots and set out to explore the peat soil basin in which Toushe is situated, a rare geological phenomenon. You begin from getting to know the flowers and plants along the roadside, jumping curiously around and getting your boots all muddy as you experience the texture of this peat soil basin. Next, you travel to a little farming village and strike a fun pose in front of a wall painting of a water buffalo. Further along, you find a fully intact 100-year-old rice milling machine in front of a temple, a scene which speaks of ancient wisdom. The final stop instantly diffuses all the heat of summer: it’s Grandma’s laundry, an antique site which has undergone renovation where cool, clear water rushes forth to clean away all the mud your clothing had just collected. As Steven relates interesting stories, you enjoy this refreshing period punctuating the end of your little journey.It was sixteen years before that Steven and Lilian, with their passion for the land, first experienced a bed and breakfast. They felt emotionally touched, and thus the dream of opening a guesthouse of their own was born. Steven went on to study construction and design, worked many long years in remodeling various spaces, and taught himself about building construction and interior design, always holding close to his heart his dream of opening his own guesthouse. “At the peak of this busy time, I had five houses just waiting for me to remodel them.” Steven saw the time and money spent in this way as his tuition fee, never once thinking of giving up. He even enrolled to study in the Department of Leisure and Tourism Management at Shu-Te University, and undertook studies in the landscape research institute of National Pingtung University of Science and Technology. “Even my professors said that I was the first student to actually bring my thesis work to actualization!” Steven happily exclaimed with a genuine, almost foolish laugh. Finally, they created their unique environmentally friendly guesthouse, based on the concepts of “ecology, lohas, and heartfelt perception” while working to include and connect with the local youth. They sought to revitalize their little farming village. Their wish: to transform travelers into roaming clouds, able to perceive a different kind of vacation.

Name: Coastline Azure
Description: Taitung｜Coastline AzureA long coast of unbroken ocean blueOne clear afternoon, you rush along Taiwan’s East coast Highway 11. As you round a corner, the vast, grassy landscape stretches out ahead of you under an azure sky. In the middle of this magnificent scene sits a welcoming, white guesthouse, resembling a countryside sketch from a European diary. Today, between the mountain and the sea, discover -- Coastline Azure. The elegance of European country lifeWalking up to Coastline Azure along the courtyard path, you see dogs at play on the lawn nearby. Remove your shoes and enter the lobby where refined leather seating and wooden furniture bespeak of the classic country life. Shirley, the owner of Coastline Azure, has decorated this space with her favorite owl imagery as well as local works of art. These eclectic elements work seamlessly together to create a style which is totally Shirley. Her floral print dress and graceful smile are as warm and bright as today’s sunshine. Shirley skillfully manages every detail at Coastline Azure, from the meticulous dinner table arrangements to the inspired decor of each room. Once a part of the bustling world of business, Shirley’s extraordinary sense brought her great success as the chief financial officer of such distinguished companies as Pizza Hut, China Synthetic Rubber Corporation and Levi’s. At the peak of her business career, Shirley also experienced the greatest mental and physical stress of her entire life. After a 21-day period of continuous work with no time off, she realized that without a doubt health turns out to be the greatest wealth. She vowed to give up her busy career and return to a simple life. A love of the Pacific Ocean led her to seek out property in Taidong, with a view of Green Island on the horizon, where she would build her own guesthouse. At Coastline Azure, Shirley delights in leading travellers back into a slower, simpler rhythm where they can enjoy a broad slice of endless azure blue. A beautiful vacation in the company of mountains and sea “We only use world-champion roast coffee beans in our house! If you’re lucky, who’s to say you won’t end up with premium Geisha coffee in your cup!” Working from her own ample experience, seasoned traveler Shirley aims to provide her guests with nothing but the best. On a leisurely afternoon, guests are welcomed by a taste of her own afternoon tea preparations: an array of exquisite and delicious snacks on a wooden platter, such as cream puffs with cool filling, handmade brownies, and Isigny butter cookies accompanied by a cup of freshly brewed coffee. Guests arriving at Coastline Azure ought to slow down and savour the fine flavor of their vacation. On the second floor, Coastline Azure has two- and four-person rooms available. Each room derives its name from the movement of the sun and moon through the sky. In the rooms called “Moon Companion” and “Star Gazing”, the warm yellow glow of the moon and the resplendent stars illuminates the pitch-black night sky. You can greet the first rays of dawn as you sit enveloped by the boundless ocean vista in rooms with the names “Listen to the Ocean” and “Sunrise”. Shirley’s meticulous planning of the small two-person loft allows guests to soak in exclusive tranquility as they sit quietly near windows, overlooking the ocean. After a night in such a room, you’ll understand that the connection to the landscape is the best part about this place. Step out onto the spacious balcony where the rhythmic slap of the waves sounds nearby and revel in the exquisite company of the sun, moon, and stars. Living by the boundless water If you feel like an even farther view, then ascend to the rooftop patio and gaze into the distance. At a glance, take in the entire coastline from Jinzun in the North to Fugang in the South. Turn toward the west and behold the mighty and continuous ridge of the mountain range. Wrapped in the embrace of both mountains and sea, forget your worries and return to the purity of yourself. With your spirit enriched and refreshed by nature, the exhaustion you brought with you has long since disappeared without a trace. At Coastline Azure, put contentment back in your step as you walk abreast the mountains and the sea and embark on your next journey.

Description: "Ma chawu" in Pinayuanan means "Excellent" The owner was a teacher before. She attended a beverage preparation course for some reason. After the owner obtained the certificate of beverage preparation, she established a beverage shop named "Ma chawu" in her village, offering tea, snacks, coffee, and locally produced fruit/vegetable juice which are loved by neighbors and visitors alike. Later, the owner started realizing that the Sapulju Tribal Village where he lives is an environment mingling beautiful natural scenery and abundant crops that outsiders visit frequently. To provide more complete services, the owner and her husband began the plan to run a homestay service. The brand-new “Ma chawu Homestay” is located at a site facing the sea and embraced by the hill at the foot of Jing Jeng Mountain. It overlooks the Pacific Ocean to welcome the first dawn in Eastern Taiwan. The homestay is simple, clean-cut and colorful in outer appearance in presenting stylish artistic beauty. Native indigenous features give this  innovative and modern homestay an authentic local touch. The “Ma chawu Homestay” is a B&B facility full of native features. By combining agricultural and indigenous art, it provides a cozy residential environment. Guests can also savor local agricultural produce and delicately prepared beverages to experience the native culture. Come and visit “Ma chawu Homestay”. Description: Coming into the zone of the historic Mountain Route of Railroad, Sanyi, Miaoli, at Shengxing Station look towards the direction of Longteng Broken Bridge, you will find Sun Green Holiday, a place filled with relaxed atmosphere and covered with greenery and flowers. Yes, this is exactly the forest feast we have prepared for you.    We always have a dream that we can develop a park belonging to us to reserve the forests and ecological lands, and to share with the traveling people. Therefore, in 2000, we started to work on Sun Green Holiday's soil preparation, planning of lines of motion, housing construction, and planting trees, bit by bit, to create an ecological Bed & Breakfast. In the 2002 Spring Festival, the operation of the B&B was officially started.    Rows of sweet-scented Osmanthus forest, camellias, huge Buddha cutters with maple trees, and other trees surround around the Sun Green Holiday, adding a bit more pastoral green to it. The retained trees to build the ecological environment in those days now seem to create a paradise for Sun Green Holiday. After so many years, Sun Green Holiday, a B&B in Sanyi, has continured changing and developing, and the young second generation has joined in with unique ideas that blending a lot of hand woodworking, painting, with spatial design, creating more colorful atmosphere to the B&B.    Cordial and passionate services are our only constant adherence, and we hope to introduce a more local culture of Sanyi to everyone.

Description: Nan Chian Jade Garden is located in Nanzhuang, amid beautiful verdant countryside beside the road leading to Donghe, about 1 km from the Nanzhuang Old Street. The appearance of Nan Chian Jade Garden is a European style of North America with a design reflecting the innkeeper's taste and intention, the overall feeling is elegant, sophisticated, and the presentation of the flow of light and shadow in the space varying with time, as well as the poetic beauties of the scenery changing window by window, makes you feel refreshing like being in a home of your earnest wish. Overnight Nen Chian Jade Garden, you can enjoy the night view of the landscape surrounding streets and the sparkling starry sky.   Nan Chian Jade Garden is a B&B certified by SGS, a certified Taiwan Host by the Tourism Bureau, MOTC, and a four-star B&B assessed by the Miaoli County Government. In short, the well-crafted Nan Chian Jade Garden is a name you can trust and a place to visit. Please make an appointment for your arrival to share the mountain quiet life together.

As an environmentally-friendly B&B, Lou Zi Xia Traditional-Style Taiwanese Bed & Breakfast complies with the Kinmen Low-Carbon Program by not automatically providing disposable toiletries or changing bedding and towels for guests staying more than one night. Qiong Lin Community is located in the center of the island, and is one of its representative communities. The original name for this area, “Pinglin,” came from the forests that used to grow nearby. It has been frequented by famous people since the Ming dynasty, when one of the emperors bestowed an honorary inscribed board from which the current name, “Qiong Lin,” is derived. A number of traditional-style Taiwanese buildings, simple and elegant, with natural charm, have been preserved here. The largest of these is the ancestral temple. During times of war, tunnels were dug around the island and it had a heavy military atmosphere; now it is open to the public. Qiong Lin was home to a number of successful scholars during the Ming and Qing dynasties, and therefore a number of ornate official residences can still be viewed here. The ancestral temples are full of inscribed boards celebrating the scholars’ achievements, and in addition to the main Cai Family Temple, several more representing the branches of the family can be found in Qiong Lin.  One building houses two of these temples. Each of the temples provides interesting sights, and along with Yi Gu Tang and two of Feng Shi Ye (Wind Lion Gods) have been designated second-grade historical sites.

Description: The three brothers (Huang Jiande, the eldest, Huang Jianchu, the second, and Huang Jianlong, the youngest), born in a family in farming for generations of Aboriginal small tribe, cherish the memory of the living environment of their innocent, passionate childhood of without lights, playing in the rice fields, going to school barefooted, feeding pigs, watering vegetables, setting up traps, pulling bamboo, shooting fish in streams, cooking and helping with housework. Suddenly, 50 years later, our journeys of life have mostly gone, and now what we are looking for is feedback and serenity, and wish to pursue a healthy, peaceful, and simple life in their remaining years.   Ever since, we have been thinking of "a falling leaf returns to the roots" and hoped that ancestral glory can come to us to help us creating a healthy living environment with the tribesmen together.  To be closer to nature, closer to the waters and mountains, and closer to creating a healthy cause, we have a dream to own a health farm, render it in a simple, natural, earthy way to allow us to have a lazy laid-back life accompanied by nature and share it with all good friends who like here.   Three brothers then actively brought the land 20 years ago. Beginning in April 2008, they have returned to tribe planning, followed by designing, in the same year on November 22 they started the construction, and officially completed the building and opened for business on October 3, 2009. We, three brothers, spent more than 2 years to complete the construction of this healthy farm.   Here has very beautiful landscapes, pleasant climate, and is an unexplored paradise on earth, where you can find a lot of amazing things in every corner. We hope the staying tourists can have the beautiful feelings comparable to traveling to the Swiss.   "Tumuyi" is my father's indigenous name. In the past, he was a farmer battling through hardship to live, inadvertently, at 38 years old, he died of hypertension and suddenly left us. To recall fondly and cherish the memory of father's kindness of bringing up us, hardworking, and helpful spirit of great love, and to awaken our descendants to attach importance to their health, the farm villa is therefore named "Tumuyi Healthy Resort."

Name: The Easy Space
Description: New Taipei｜The Easy SpaceParty time on the coast in an old fishing villageHow long has it been since you went on a trip to see the ocean with a big group of friends, to have a few drinks and sing songs until the sun comes up? Make the arrangements, claim a weekend for your own, board a vehicle heading for the seaside, and make a beeline for a youthful party -- The Easy Space is the perfect villa for a carefree, seaside vacation.Vacation space in a villaTravelling along the seaside, only an hour by car from Taipei city, you come to an old forgotten fishing village in Gongliao bay. A faded red brick European style villa overlooks the ocean and reminds you of the former magnificence of the area. You pull the heavy glass doors open and step instantly into a different world. A lazy bossanova jazz tune resounds in your ears as you take in the extraordinary style of the living room with its high ceiling and crystal chandeliers. Seven-meter tall floor-to-ceiling windows allow you to take in the blue sky, the ocean, and the mountain ranges outside. The Easy Space was in fact originally a gift from the father of the hostess, Amber, to her grandfather on his 60th birthday 12 years earlier. Amber’s grandfather had left his hometown in the struggle to make a living and, despite achieving professional success, had always longed to return. With grandpa’s dream of returning to the countryside in his mind, Amber’s father went home and built the most fashionable European-style villa of the time.For the current hostess, Amber, The Easy Space brings back memories of beautiful vacations with friends. After leaving a pleasant life in the USA and returning to Taiwan for her family, Amber helped to revamp their old family villa, with the goal of allowing those fond childhood memories to live on. Upon her return, Amber also met her love, Michael. Now, through the everyday happiness of The Easy Space, the two of them share their mutual love and appreciation with every traveler who stays with them.Five secret oceanside bays for five different roomsYet the biggest surprise in this space measuring 250 ping isn’t the 100-inch Blu-ray home theater; there’s also KTV equipment, a sauna and steam room, a cocktail bar, and a fully equipped gym! There’s even a small reading room filled with Amber’s beloved collection of Japanese manga. Furthermore, plans are in the works to build an outdoor cafe with an ocean view for the enjoyment of The Easy Space guests.All five rooms here at The Easy Space were renovated by Amber and Michael’s own skillful hands to create a fresh aesthetic environment. If you love a big room, with a grand view of the ocean and sky, then your first choice will certainly be the “oceanside and sky” suite on the second floor, which puts you closest to the vast ocean and sky. The “fisherman’s bay” suite on the first floor is equally large and gives you the same generous front row seat to beautiful scenery. Around to the side, you find the “garden scenery” suite in the color of violets, a space situated just right to give you a view of both mountains and sea from the balcony.Though it doesn’t directly face the ocean, the “mountain and sea landscape” suite on the second floor is painted an enchanting Tiffany blue, and presents an irresistible choice for travelers. If you love the simplicity of the mountains and long to hide away in comfort and security, then the “hilltop cloud” suite was designed precisely for you. With large windows facing majestic mountains and one entire wall painted with a tunnel motif, you’re left wondering where that road into the distance may lead. Tonight, you may take a train ride in your dreams, setting off for a paradise where friendships are eternal.The forgotten, yet most beautiful, fishing village in the northeastAfter finishing Amber’s delicious homemade breakfast, take a walk into the village under a clear, azure sky. Maoao Fishing Village, the most beautiful fishing village in the whole northeast, lies between Taipei and Yilan and is extremely close to the villa. Once bustling and lively, it now lies tranquil and serene. Old houses are preserved and exude a generous and friendly ambiance. You greet an elderly neighbor resting in the shade of a doorway, and play with the kittens rolling around in the sunshine. You snap a few photographs as you reluctantly prepare to leave, taking beautiful memories back with you.The ocean breeze gently blows as you look back up the hillside to The Easy Space, and images of the flourishing and decline of the fishing village play in your mind. The faded red brick building before you holds aloft the resplendent colors of youth, inviting you and your friends to make plans to return soon to this quaint fishing village in the northeast.

Name: Cat Sky Country B&B
Description: Yilan｜Cat Sky HouseFollow the cat to a playful old house in the countrysideA comfortable autumn breeze blows through Yilan, as the Annong River reflects the dazzling sunlight. Strolling along a country lane between farmers’ fields as chickens cluck and dogs bark, you somehow feel like closing your eyes when suddenly your gaze is caught by a building colored red and orange: Cat Sky House, the brightest traditional courtyard home on the bank of the Annong River, sits waiting between rice paddies for travelers to visit.Rich and delightful countryside courtyard homeWalking into the courtyard at Cat Sky House, everything is brightly colored, with cute, playfully arranged scenes all around. The courtyard preserves the traditional cement ground covering, as grass grows in cracks that opened up in the cement many years before. Several cats, stretching out beneath a red sun parasol, continue rolling around. Your host Lisa walks toward you with a smile. After retirement, she and her husband, Paul bought this house, originally in ruins, for the street cats that they had adopted. They have since remodeled it into a cute courtyard house full of cats. The moment you enter the house, you are greeted by a warm aroma - you discover that it’s the smell of the home-baked welcome cookies being prepared by Miss Tian, the housekeeper. In the kitchen, the same warm color theme you have seen elsewhere at Cat Sky House continues, and the old wood-burning hearth remains as well. Watching Miss Tian’s busy movements, you feel a sense of returning to your family home in the countryside.And why have they chosen Yilan as the place to pursue life after retirement? Originally living in Taipei, Lisa says with a laugh, “We do it all for these little animals!” Following the growth and independence of her children, Lisa gradually started to adopt cats. First one, then another, then a third… the more cat adoption information she saw, the more she took in, and before she knew it she had seven or eight cats living in her home! A while later, after going on a trip with several friends, they suddenly became inspired to buy a house in Yilan where they could retire to one day, to live together and take care of one another. This was the birth of Cat Sky House. As Lisa says with a laugh, “You have to have your own life!” Retirement is not the finale, it is the start of a new life.Peaceful, easy times in the countryCat Sky House only entertains a single group of guests at any given time, so you can relax completely and enjoy the company of your friends in your own exclusive building. This country-style home filled with miscellaneous goods will set you completely at ease. Stepping into the bedroom, you take in the colorful decor on the roof beams, as well as the cute figurines lying on the bed and in front of the windows. The pristine white sheets are soft and welcoming, inviting you to fall asleep to the singing sounds of insects.Walking outdoors, Paul excitedly shows you the sweet potato leaves he just picked in order to give traveling guests the most natural, flavorful breakfast possible the following morning. At this time, however, a sumptuous afternoon tea has been prepared to welcome you, and it is up to you whether you enjoy it outdoors or inside. Sitting in a corner of the courtyard, admiring the expansive country fields and the soothing breeze, you enjoy passionfruit jam on handmade cookies with hibiscus wax gourd tea. Chickens cluck as they walk around the courtyard in a scene that seems right out of a peaceful, pastoral painting.A sumptuous countryside breakfastYou wake at the break of dawn to the sound of clucking chickens, barking dogs and the aromatic breakfast that awaits you. Walking to the breakfast table, you’ll certainly be shocked at first sight of the table full of sumptuous foods. You may even think you’ve overslept and your hosts have skipped right to preparing lunch! Besides Paul’s own sweet potato leaves and corn, there is a host of other seasonal vegetables. Delicious egg flatbreads sprinkled with cilantro delight the taste buds. Lisa proudly states, “Our egg flatbreads are made with indica rice milk, making them softer, and they’re really hard to come by!” At that moment, the housekeeper delivers a freshly baked pizza to the table! The melted cheese invites you to eat just one more slice. After you are full, Lisa will provide you with all the info you need about local sights to see.Cat Sky House maintains the old-school retro lifestyle and pastoral tranquility of an old courtyard home in the countryside. In such a place, time simply slows down. With Lisa’s humor and Paul’s warmth, you’ll certainly see how genuine the interaction between people can be. When you arrive at Cat Sky House, you’ll see just how fun the countryside can be. In this old courtyard home, you can even follow the cats’ lead, to gaze upon a new slice of sky.

Name: Chang House
Description: Yilan｜Chang HouseA Dwelling That Breathes Along with NatureFollowing the perfectly straight country road, you drive into a golden rice paddy with farm houses scattered throughout. Rolling down the window, you stretch your head out to admire Yilan’s pastoral landscape, the rice stalks by the roadside laiden with grain sway in the gentle breeze to welcome travelers. Following the road signs onwards, you approach your destination: Chang House, in perfect harmony with the natural world, and enveloped in the breeze rich with the aroma of rice.Tasting local refreshments in a classic Yilan residenceHanson is the owner of Chang House. Wearing a warm smile and wooden clogs, he walks out to greet you, leading you along the slate pathway into the back yard. Pushing open the screen door, the wind and sunlight dance together as you see the unique desserts and traditional refreshments that Chang and the housekeepers have prepared for you. As they place the local flavors of Yilan upon the table, you admire the plate arrangement and local ingredients. Taste a bite of kumkuat, enjoying the sweet & sour flavor; salted plum cakes, a local delicacy, stuffed with dehydrated fruit, get sweeter the longer they are chewed; roasted wheat flour tea with a sprinkle of crispy bun cake combines the most classic traditional flavors; wash it all down with a cup of warm honey peach black tea to warm the stomach and the heart.Designed by famous architect Huang Sheng-yuan, Chang House is the most representative residential building in Yilan. The height of the ground floor allows one to appreciate both the view of the fields and the painting-like mountain scenery. Slow down your pace and appreciate the rhythmic interaction between the courtyard and the surrounding natural environment. Even when sitting indoors under the midday sun, you can sense the movement of the wind. The sun floods indoors through large floor-to-ceiling windows, bright and warm. The cubic structure, the square-shaped courtyard, the single pink plumeria tree highlight the year-round beauty of Chang House.A home accordant with nature and founded on peopleEight years in construction, Chang House is founded upon people, accordant with nature, and fused with the local culture. “Looking down at the design of our house from above, you can see the square-within-a-square shape  of the Chinese character for return. It is built upon the concept of home, which is precisely what I wanted.” In order to implement this ideal, Hanson waited eight years for the design and construction to be completed. He used patience and trust to exchange for what he loved most.Moving alone from Yilan to Taipei, Hanson got a job as a hairdresser after graduating from high school in order to help ease his family’s economic pressure. Along the way, he met the most important person in his life - Sister Lan. After saving a bit of money, they decided to move together to Yilan and build a home they could call their own. Even though an accident quietly took Sister Lan from this world, her warm spirit had already had a profound influence on Chang House. Hanson says that the property upon which Chang House is built was bought by Sister Lan, so no matter what, he must continue her dream of making her dreamland a reality.The greatest luxury is in fact very simpleChang House’s five suites have all been named after the rooms formerly inhabited by members of Hanson’s family: the Master Bedroom, the Mother Room, the Eldest Daughter Room, the Little Daughter Room, and the Guest Room. All rooms are simple and elegant, while retaining a cozy warmth. Hanson lived with his family in this home for ten years before deciding to share it with the outside world, allowing even more people to stay in a local Yilan residence. His hope was that travelers could also share in their experience of life in this special living room and in this courtyard.In the morning, you enjoy a delicious Chinese-style home cooked meal made entirely of seasonal vegetables and fruit grown in their own garden. Afterwards, you lie in the spacious front yard enjoying the aroma of the rice paddies. In the afternoon, you curl up in a corner of the courtyard with a book. The evening is the most important time of day at Chang House - you climb to the rooftop from where you can enjoy the expansive natural scenery. This is the most magical moment of all, when the golden sun setting beneath orange clouds creates a splendid play of light and shadow across the open fields. It has been said that human beings require sunlight, air, water, and trees. After coming to Chang House, you realize that all you need to do is open your eyes and relax your mind, and all at once, all of these wonderful elements are yours!

Description: Taitung｜Juhu VillaJourney to a mountain residence of endless surprisesYou drive along a winding mountain road and the silence along the way gives you the feeling that you’re about to arrive at a secluded, secret place. The natural scenery out the car window excites you as you approach Juhu Villa; a quiet place brimming with vitality.A treasure chest of natural wonders deep in the mountainsXiao Hei, the lively little black dog, approaches the car to welcome you upon arrival. You see baskets of freshly-picked tangerines, and a bunch of hardy bananas on a wooden table. Wearing simple clothing and a bashful smile, your amiable host, Jin-Tian, approaches. Pointing to the freshly harvested bananas on the table, he says, “Have some! Don’t be shy!” This place exudes a generous and friendly ambiance. With no neighbors in sight, you quickly make the acquaintance of the sky, the earth, and the abundant wildlife.You walk with Jin-Tian up a sloping road towards the independent lodging area. Beautiful primrose blossoms line the road, butterflies dancing between them. Xiao Hei and the endless mountain scenery accompany you on your stroll as you feel your mind and body being cleansed. Jin-Tian points to the distant mountains on either side, saying, “Our land extends from here to there…” He names for you the many tree and plant species along the way; tomatoes, persimmons, dragon fruit, banana... “Listen! That’s the call of the muntjac deer!” Pointing once again to the far off mountain ridge, “Formosan serows inhabit those mountains!” Jin-Tian is even able to climb up the wire obstacle course they have set up with his bare hands, or quickly ascend the trees above the river valley like a young boy playing in the mountains. Following his footsteps, you feel like you are exploring a treasure chest full of natural wonders, discovering endless surprises.A mountain household with a view of the Pacific OceanAfter climbing the steep road, you catch your breath on the mountain terrace looking out between the high mountains. Suddenly you catch a glimpse of light reflecting off azure waters: the faraway Pacific Ocean. As the sea breeze blows by and you take a deep breath, you feel just like a mountain spirit.Three white bungalows sit to one side of the road, simple and elegant. French windows allow the beautiful scenery to merge into each residence. In the Maroon Oriole Residence, furnished in the style of a Chinese court, you feel immersed in the refinement of the pink and red decor. In the mustard yellow decor of the Collared Scops Owl Residence, you enter the magnificence of classical European style. The colors of the Formosan Blue Magpie Residence are just as lively as the bird for which it is named, with elements of maritime Greece mixed in, giving you the impression of an ocean voyage. No matter which residence you inhabit, all have a spacious balcony overlooking the mountains, and a large bathtub in a roomy bathroom to help spoil your world-weary body.Make your way to a world-class villa with unparallelled mountain viewsThe sky is still light after you finish checking in, and Xiao Hei seems to know that you want to go out to play, bouncing around and wagging his tail. Jin-Tian has finished his farming work and invites you to experience an activity with a set itinerary. With expectation and excitement, you and your friends jump aboard the little blue work truck as the steep mountain road and beautiful environs foretell of the unimaginable journey to come. Jin-Tian stops the truck on a flat section of the hillside as a crested goshawk spirals above your head and into the distance. Looking down you see the Changbin plains and the Pacific Ocean beyond. You seem to be able to make out Green Island in the fog off the coast. Hanging from a large tree by the hillside is a swing, and after being reassured by Jin-Tian, you bravely give it a try. Your extended legs feel the rushing of the wind as you surge forward, gripping the ropes tightly in your hands. You feel like a small bird enjoying the swiftness of soaring through the air. You feel you might even be able to jump into the Pacific Ocean before you. You can’t believe that such a private, world-class scenic spot could exist here in Taiwan.After dark, Jin-Tian’s wife, Mei-jyu, prepares a full table of organic cuisine for you. After dinner, you chat with your friends in the open air mountainside dining area, enjoying the comforts of this farming household. Afterwards, you might again explore the mountain environment with Jin-Tian, encountering once more a little muntjac deer, a flying squirrel, or perhaps an owl.In the early morning light, you enjoy a multicolored vegetarian breakfast. Deep in the mountains, you experience the beauty of a more primitive lifestyle, exploring the precious surprises that nature offers. When it is time to leave, your reluctance to leave transforms into immense gratitude as you give thanks to the rich offerings of the natural world, and to Jin-Tian and Mei-jyu for their passionate love of nature and their unreserved sharing.

Description: Discovering Zileju(Cicada-Home). Zile is another name for Cicada. Zileju is situated on Mei Lun Mountain in Hualien City. There is a Pine Garden next to it. In this beautiful environment, you can often hear the chirping sound of cicada that seems to be urging us to quickly step into this beautiful environment; therefore, we called our home stay “cicada.” Here, you can enjoy a great view of Hualien City. To the right, there is the Central Mountain Range, and, to the left, is the Coastal Mountain Range. In this natural scenery, you are far from the disturbance of the noisy city, and enjoy the most grand and simple baptism of Mother Nature.  When you step into Zileju, Taiwan red pines and an array of stars greet you. The purple-dancing Cape Primrose, pink and romantic morning glory, and lavender also welcome you. We provide the most friendly service, the most comfortable facilities and enjoyment, allowing you to unwind and forget the stress of work by bathing in the mountains, sea, sunlight, and air of Hualien. Zileju welcomes guests who have taste and a love for nature. The day and night of Hualien: Morning- Sunlight shines on the newly awakened Hualien City. The sunlight shines through, and lights up the grand Central Mountain Range, and also shines on the beautiful Pacific Ocean. Sunset- Afterglow sweeps across the sky, a breeze gently blows, starlight and street lights are faintly discernible. Night- Looking over Hualien night scene, you see glittering lights, as moon light gently shines on the ground and stars twinkle on the sky. The croaking of frogs and chirping sounds of cicadas is like a natural symphony. We serve a delicious breakfast, personally made by the inn keeper, consisting of a tasty hamburger, together with fresh and tasty lettuce salad and seasonal fruits; as for drinks, guests can choose juice, hot cocoa, or hot coffee. After eating breakfast, you will have all the nourishment and energy you need for the day !

Name: Ocean Paradise Resort
Description: Pingtung｜Ocean Paradise ResortEndless azure views from a resort beside the seaUp in the mountains of Kenting, beside the endless azure ocean, you discover a beautiful, pure white guesthouse. Two buildings sit like the two wings of an angel overlooking the sea and the human world. After circumventing the small town of Hengchun and driving past endless rolling hills and grasslands, the Ocean Paradise Resort appears before you, your companion for a beautiful vacation.Blessings of sea and sun in a white dreamlandThe sea breeze in southern Taiwan, the shrubbery along the road, and the midsummer sun all feels like a beautiful daydream. Your car stops before the distant scenery of the eight great mountain ranges which surround the small town of Hengchun. You look out at the pair of buildings with white walls like the two wings of an angel speckled with small windows, each one hiding the angel’s secrets. A couple of wiener dogs rush towards you wagging their tails, with your host Lisa waving and smiling at you, welcoming you to this tranquil, white dreamland. Walking indoors, you see the azure sky and deep, blue sea through the large French windows, and all of the exhaustion you may have carried with you along your journey slips away into that distant azure horizon. Next, you enjoy delightful afternoon tea on the lawn, tasting desserts and admiring the scenery. You walk with your special friend to the ocean lookout and wonder at the beauty of the golden sunset, offering each other a kiss under the blessings of sea and sun.Twelve guest rooms offer a vacation in the company of the seaTwelve rooms, like twelve keys to happiness - Daybreak, Splendid Sun, Sunset, Moonlight, White Cloud, Blue Sky, Rainbow, Starry Sky, Meadow, Jade Wave, Spring Breeze, Summer Peace - each room providing beautiful vacation scenery to accompany you.Each four-person suite is sure to provide your family with warm memories; the outdoor gardens overflow with verdant scenery, the red Chinese hibiscus in full bloom provide the perfect backdrop for solid-wood, Southeast Asian furnishings as pleasant music plays in the background. In the simplicity of “Double Room A” the lapping sea provides the background music as you recline on the balcony in wooden lounge chairs discussing life. “Double Room B” has additional mountain-view windows and is relaxed and comfortable. The “VIP Double Room” is the most attractive of all, with a bathtub that offers an ocean view, allowing for the tender enjoyment of both water and sunlight. In the evening, if you are lucky, you may pull open the curtains to behold the moonlight sparkling on the surface of the ocean, with the Milky Way sparkling overhead.Happiness in the Kenting hillsWhen morning breaks, you and your special friend walk to the first-floor dining room and choose a table near the windows where you enjoy a delicious breakfast beside the ever-present blue sea. You pick up your book to read a few pages while your partner writes in a journal, both of you enjoying this tranquil time.Children frolic with the weiner dogs on the lawn outside the window, while the cattle ruminate over the grass in the neighboring field. You feel like you’re in nature’s paradise. The ocean is like a secret left in the human world by the angels. In this place, you feel like blessings are always near, as if that distant ocean is always nearby.

Name: Lake Side Resort
Description: The construction of the Lake Side Resort was commenced by the Fu Li Development Co, Ltd. in 1995 and the hotel opened in March 1999. In 1999, the Fu Chuan Development International Co, Ltd. was awarded the "Promotion of Private Participation in the Tourism and Recreation Infrastructure in Puli Liyu Lake Scenic Area Project" by the Nantou County government. Facilities were added, such as 116 rooms from the previous 68, a floating restaurant and Lotus Cafe. The hotel is the only recreation and holiday hotel built at Liyu Lake in Puli, Nantou. From here, guests can reach Puli downtown by a 10 minute ride. To ensure guests' safety during their stay and indulgence in the wonderful lake view, the hotel is constructed with a highly safe steel structure that endured the 921 earthquake of 1999, taking a perfect score for its structural safety. The hotel consists of 4 main buildings. When you enter the lobby, you will see the stairs on both sides connecting to the carefully designed conference hall on the 2nd floor. The conference hall is suitable for holding meeting and training activities by organizations. In buildings A, B and C, rooms of different types, styles and sizes are available to meet guests' needs. Lake Side Resort is located right on the carp site of the Seven Carp Lake auspicious sites. A long time ago, before the willow causeway was built, the Carp Lake resembles a lively and shiny carp. When the sun sets, the crimson light shines on the lake surface as if the scales of a swaying fish . The reason why the willow causeway came into existence can be traced back to legends of various sources. I have always favored the legend that the Japanese built the causeway to penetrate the part of the lake resembling the fish maw when Taiwan was under Japanese rule for fear of any talent incubated from the power of Feng Shui. As in Feng Shui, there is a saying that destiny comes first, fate second and Feng Shui third and this is upheld by the Chinese. And the Japanese did it to sabotage the power of Feng Shui here. Whatever the case may be, this brought us a view comparable to the willow causeway in the West Lake. And you can enjoy it with your own eyes. Never miss the spot when you are around.
